task: We want to add 20 charging points by 1 March 2027. Using the observed usage data, which existing sites/areas show the highest saturation and are the best candidates? Give a ranked shortlist with the data behind it.
markdown:
> MOCK — scripted, no AI model. Numbers come from real tool calls on the local cache.

## Answer
The most saturated sites in the observed window are BZ_C_RISPARMIO_01 (66.9% occupancy), BZ_P_VITTORIA (63.5% occupancy), BZ_BOEHLER_01 (57.0% occupancy) [E2]. They are the first candidates for the new charging points, subject to the coverage caveats below.

## Key findings
- **BZ_C_RISPARMIO_01**: occupancy 66.9%, all points busy 46.2% of observed time, 203 observed starts [E2].
- BZ_C_RISPARMIO_01 data quality: coverage 14.7%, 437 gaps over 120 minutes [E4].
- **BZ_P_VITTORIA**: occupancy 63.5%, all points busy 27.7% of observed time, 135 observed starts [E2].
- BZ_P_VITTORIA data quality: coverage 8.2%, 757 gaps over 120 minutes [E4].
- **BZ_BOEHLER_01**: occupancy 57.0%, all points busy 57.0% of observed time, 170 observed starts [E2].
- BZ_BOEHLER_01 data quality: coverage 22.7%, 196 gaps over 120 minutes [E4].
- Longest fully-occupied share: BZ_BOEHLER_01 at 57.0% [E3].
- 22 sites were excluded for less than 24 hours of observable time [E2].

## Recommendation
Shortlist, in order: BZ_C_RISPARMIO_01, BZ_P_VITTORIA, BZ_BOEHLER_01. Split the 20 new points across these sites, starting where all points are busy most often, and validate each with a site visit and grid-capacity check before committing.

## Limitations & unknowns
- Status observations measure occupancy only, not energy, sessions or unmet demand [E1].
- Analysis window 2026-09-19..2026-11-14 (56 days); hours with gaps over 120 minutes are excluded, so coverage is partial [E1].
- Bolzano is a bounding box, not the municipal boundary. No forecasts are used.

## Sources
- [E1] dataset_overview() — Open Data Hub South Tyrol e-mobility, window 2026-09-19..2026-11-14
- [E2] rank_sites(metric=occupancy, area=bolzano, top_n=5, order=desc) — Open Data Hub South Tyrol e-mobility, window 2026-09-19..2026-11-14
- [E3] rank_sites(metric=full_time, area=bolzano, top_n=5, order=desc) — Open Data Hub South Tyrol e-mobility, window 2026-09-19..2026-11-14
- [E4] data_quality() — Open Data Hub South Tyrol e-mobility, window 2026-09-19..2026-11-14
